description: List the current user's visible (own + shared) tasks, optionally filtered. By default only open (incomplete) tasks are returned; pass include_completed: true to also include completed and skipped tasks. Filter uses the same syntax as the app: '+project', '@context', 'due:YYYY-MM-DD', negation with '!'. Returns tasks as JSON array with id, content, projects, contexts, due_on, and other fields.

include_completed.description: Set to true to also return completed and skipped tasks

name: list_tasks
